# Chakrio

> AI-powered property booking automation for boutique hotels, villas, homestays, and guesthouses worldwide. Property managers record bookings, cancellations, and expenses by sending plain-language messages via WhatsApp or Telegram. The dashboard updates automatically.

## What is Chakrio?

Chakrio is a SaaS tool for independent hospitality operators. You send a message like "Alex, 3 nights from 15 June, $200 advance" and Chakrio logs the booking instantly. No spreadsheets, no forms, no manual entry.

## Key Features

- Booking, cancellation, and expense recording via WhatsApp or Telegram chat message
- AI extracts guest name, dates, amounts, and booking type from plain-language messages
- Real-time dashboard with revenue, expenses, and occupancy
- Automated guest experience: booking confirmation → payment reminder → mid-stay care → review request
- OTA iCal calendar sync (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, etc.)
- WhatsApp broadcast campaigns to past guests
- Monthly P&L report delivered automatically on the 1st
- Multi-property support under one account
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required

## Who uses Chakrio?

Owner-operators of boutique hotels, villas, homestays, guesthouses, B&Bs, and vacation rentals. Used by property managers across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
